_comment: 2021 BMW R18 KOMBI addressing, APK-DERIVED. This profile is deliberately
verified=false so the loader REFUSES it for real transmission. The addressing
below is recovered from MotoScan 1.110 static analysis (docs/diag-kombi-findings.md)
and is strong evidence, but APK evidence alone does NOT prove the specific 2021
R18 ECU variant will accept it on a real, healthy diagnostic bus. Flipping
verified to true is a human GO decision that requires the prerequisites in
docs/diag-kombi-probe.md (confirmed diagnostic tap + healthy acknowledged bus).
Addressing [APK]: tester 0x6F1, KOMBI target byte 0x60, response id 0x660,
BMW extended addressing (tx ext = target 0x60, rx ext = tester 0xF1),

kombi.evidence: MotoScan 1.110 smali: cr.c(I) const 0x60 (cr.smali:2200); vq4.x ATSH6F1/ATCEA60/ATCF660 (vq4.smali:4455-4490); extended-addr response id 0x660. APK-derived, not bike-confirmed.
